not_dispatchable.austinpc: The hub, and the machine the dispatcher itself runs on. A dispatch here would run make check beside the runner against the same shared .venv, the same coverage directory and the same corvis_test database -- the three-way contention this whole package exists to escape. Enabled in the identity registry because it must answer for tunnels and DNS, which is a different question from whether work may be sent to it.
not_dispatchable.lapis-lazuli: An Android phone in Termux. A client of the fleet and never a target: it submits dispatches, it does not run them. Named here rather than left silent because that is a permanent decision, not a machine waiting to be onboarded.
not_dispatchable.serendipity: The operator's own Yoga 9 laptop, enrolled 2026-09-12 and reachable from the hub. Held out of dispatch UNTIL the operator says it takes work: it is a machine he uses, and a measured budget (cores, RAM, whether it stays on AC) has not been taken. Move it to `nodes` with that budget when he decides; this line is the hold, not the verdict.
not_dispatchable.pendragon: The operator's ASUS ROG Ally (Ryzen Z1 Extreme, Zen 4, AVX-512), re-provisioned 2026-09-15 and reachable from the hub. Held out of dispatch UNTIL the operator says it takes work, the same hold as serendipity and for the same reason: it is a machine he uses, and no budget (cores, RAM, sustained thermal headroom on a handheld) has been measured. Two things a future budget must account for that the other nodes do not have: ten ASUS services manage power and thermal profiles here and may override what the dispatcher assumes, and Armoury Crate holds the battery at 80%. Move it to `nodes` with a measured budget when he decides; this line is the hold, not the verdict.
not_dispatchable.lenovoold: The operator's older Yoga 3 (i5-5200U Broadwell: AVX2, no AVX-512; 8 GB; Windows 10 22H2, end of support October 2025), enrolled 2026-09-12 and reachable from the hub. Not a CI dispatch target: 8 GB is under any project's worker budget once the OS and a runner are resident, and an EOL OS should not run CI. That hold is about THIS dispatcher; it never governed a manual measurement over ssh, and the operator explicitly authorised one on 2026-09-13 ('run the sweep on lenovoold'): the NavProbe CPU control sweep, board task 62fb6c7f, the AVX2-without-AVX-512 rung the fleet had never measured. Revisit dispatch only if it is reimaged to a supported OS and the operator asks.
